summary: All 9 tests present, correctly encode contract Interfaces 1–15, use @/ alias, and cover all 6 acceptance criteria plus the DB-independence edge case.

tests_reviewed.comment: Correctly imports GET via @/ alias, calls with new Request(...), and asserts status===200, content-type includes application/json, and body deep-equals { status: HEALTH_STATUS }. Matches Interface 1 post-conditions exactly and covers AC-3.

Deletes process.env.DATABASE_URL, invokes GET, asserts 200 + { status: 'ok' }, and correctly restores only when original was defined (delete is idempotent when original was undefined). Matches Interface 1 pre-condition and the DB-independence edge case.

Correctly runs spawnSync('npx', ['tsc', '--noEmit']) with cwd=repoRoot and asserts status===0 per Interface 6. Concern: no per-test timeout override was applied to the it() block. Vitest's default test timeout is 5000ms; spawnSync has a 60s ceiling but the surrounding test will fail early if tsc exceeds 5s (plausible on cold runs). Suggest appending `, 60_000` to the it() call, matching the pattern used in scripts.test.ts. Non-blocking.
Checks fs.existsSync and non-empty trimmed content. Matches Interface 10 requirements exactly.
Uses the exact regex from Interface 10: /(password|secret|key)\s*=\s*[a-zA-Z0-9+\/]{16,}/i. Assertion via not.toMatch. Correct.

tests_reviewed.test_name: .env.example > contains at least one variable key
tests_reviewed.comment: Uses /^[A-Z_]+=.*/m as prescribed by Interface 10. Correct.

tests_reviewed.test_name: npm scripts > npm run lint exits 0
tests_reviewed.comment: spawnSync with 30_000 ms timeout and it() override — matches impl-context.md testing style. Asserts status===0 per Interface 4. Correct.

tests_reviewed.test_name: npm scripts > npm run format:check exits 0
tests_reviewed.comment: Uses the locked script name `format:check` (per contract disambiguation log), 30_000 ms timeout, asserts status===0. Correct.

tests_reviewed.test_name: npm scripts > npm run build exits 0 and produces .next/
tests_reviewed.comment: spawnSync with 120_000 ms it() timeout, asserts status===0 AND fs.existsSync(.next/). Matches Interface 4 build semantics and AC-6.
Matches /\.env\*?\.local/ which accepts both the exact glob `.env*.local` and `.env.local`. Aligns with Interface 3 semantics.

tests_reviewed.test_name: README.md > documents npm run dev or npm start
tests_reviewed.comment: Regex /npm run dev|npm start/i matches Interface 15.

suggestions: typescript.test.ts: add a per-test timeout override (e.g. `it('tsc --noEmit exits 0', () => { ... }, 60_000)`) so a cold `tsc --noEmit` run does not trip Vitest's 5000ms default test timeout before the 60s spawnSync ceiling is reached. Aligns with the timeout pattern used in scripts.test.ts.

gitignore.test.ts: `fs.readFileSync` is executed at module load (outside describe). If `.gitignore` is missing, the whole test file crashes rather than reporting per-test failures. Consider moving the read inside a `beforeAll` or into each `it` block for cleaner failure reporting. Cosmetic; contract guarantees the file exists.

Acceptance-criterion coverage confirmed via traceability: AC-1 (Test 3, 7), AC-2 (Tests 4, 8), AC-3 (Tests 1, 2), AC-4 (Tests 5, 6), AC-5 (Test 9), AC-6 (Tests 5, 6, 7). All 6 ACs are covered by at least one test; DB-independence edge case is covered by Test 2. Node-version pinning is intentionally not automated per test-plan 'Not tested' section.
